sections: This capture session records vehicle condition evidence for a claim file.
Participation is voluntary; you may pause or stop at any time without penalty.
The session captures vehicle photographs and a VIN plate image. It does not decode your VIN, authenticate the vehicle, or make ownership claims.
Captured originals are stored at full resolution and may be shared with your insurance carrier, a repair shop, or a dealership as part of claim handling.
No payment or compensation is offered or implied for participation in this capture session.
By proceeding you affirmatively consent to the capture described above.
